attempts.summary: Configured a 3-node MariaDB Galera cluster (node1, node2, node3, AlmaLinux 9.6, MariaDB 10.5 with galera provider from AppStream). Verified multi-master write/read replication across all members, verified continued availability with one member stopped (quorum preserved, size 2), and verified automatic resync (IST) when the stopped member returned (rejoined, size 3, Synced, and recovered the write made while it was down). Completed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on all three nodes: baseline captured, one node rebooted at a time via `systemctl reboot`, boot_id verified changed on each, and full cluster health/data verified recovered before moving to the next node.
